name: oma-solorpg
author: cabral
description: A solo virtual tabletop for Omarchy, with your default agent as the game master. Ironsworn plays free, with no book; Dragonbane is built from your own copy of its books. The Book tells the story: live narration, dice moments, scene title cards, a text portrait that reacts to your hero, fights drawn in text and a codex. The Table beside it holds the sheet, rolls, rests, light and the oracle, and the desktop joins in: border flashes, candlelight, omens.

barWidget.description: A d20 that opens the Table (right click: the Book); it shows the hero's state
